Best Workers Comp Attorney in Concord – Fighting for Injured Workers

If you're searching for the best workers comp attorney in Concord, Franco Muñoz Law Firm is here to protect your rights. Concord, California, is home to hardworking employees in industries such as healthcare, retail, construction, and transportation. Workplace injuries can leave you struggling with medical bills, lost wages, and uncertainty about your future. Our experienced workers’ compensation attorneys in Concord are dedicated to securing the benefits you deserve.

Need more details on workers' compensation benefits? Read our guide on disability ratings in workers’ compensation cases.

Why Choose Franco Muñoz Law Firm in Concord?

Our Concord office offers the same experience and commitment that has made us one of the most trusted workers’ comp law firms in the Bay Area. Here’s why injured workers turn to us:

  • Local Knowledge: We understand Concord’s workforce and are familiar with major employers, from shopping centers like Sunvalley Shopping Center to the growing transportation and construction sectors.
  • Decades of Experience: We have handled thousands of workers' compensation claims in California, recovering millions of dollars for injured workers.
  • Bilingual Services: We offer representation in English and Spanish, ensuring clear communication for all clients.
  • No Fees Until We Win: You won’t pay legal fees unless we successfully recover benefits or a settlement for you.

For official California workers' compensation regulations, visit the California Division of Workers' Compensation.

How to Navigate the Workers’ Compensation Process in Concord

Filing a workers’ compensation claim in Concord can feel overwhelming, especially while recovering from an injury. Our experienced attorneys will guide you through every step of the process to ensure you receive the compensation you deserve.

  1. Report Your Injury: Notify your employer immediately after a workplace injury to protect your claim.
  2. Seek Medical Attention: Get treatment from an approved provider such as John Muir Medical Center or a certified workers' comp specialist in Concord.
  3. File Your Claim: Our legal team will help you complete and submit the DWC-1 form to ensure your claim is properly filed.
  4. Build Your Case: We collect medical records, witness statements, and expert opinions to strengthen your case.
  5. Secure Your Benefits: If your claim is approved, you may be entitled to compensation for medical expenses, lost wages, and permanent disability.

Workers’ Compensation Benefits Available in Concord

California law provides a range of benefits to injured employees. Our team will fight to ensure you receive the full compensation you are entitled to, including:

  • Medical Treatment: Full coverage for doctor visits, hospital stays, surgeries, medications, and rehabilitation therapy.
  • Temporary Disability Benefits: Wage replacement while you recover from your work-related injury.
  • Permanent Disability Benefits: Compensation for permanent impairments that impact your ability to work.
  • Supplemental Job Displacement Benefits: Vocational training vouchers if you cannot return to your previous job.
  • Death Benefits: Financial support for dependents if a worker passes away due to a workplace accident.

To learn more about how workers’ compensation benefits are calculated, visit our guide on determining disability levels.

Need help with your workers’ compensation claim? Contact Franco Muñoz Law Firm today for a free case evaluation or call us at (667) 350-1072.  We believe we are the best workers comp attorneys in Concord.

Common Workplace Injuries in Concord

Concord has a diverse economy that exposes workers to a variety of occupational risks depending on their industry. We assist workers with claims for injuries such as:

  • Construction Accidents: Falls, machinery failures, and exposure to hazardous materials.
  • Retail Injuries: Slip-and-fall accidents, lifting injuries, and repetitive strain injuries.
  • Healthcare Sector Injuries: Back strains, needlestick injuries, and exposure to infectious diseases.
  • Transportation and Logistics Accidents: Collisions and injuries related to loading and unloading goods.
  • Repetitive Stress Injuries: Common in office and administrative jobs.

Our Location in Concord

Our office is conveniently located in the heart of Concord to serve local residents and surrounding communities. Whether you live near Clayton Road or in the residential areas of North Concord, we are here to help.
